item.title: McAllen, PSJA school districts reject school prayer bill
item.description: The McAllen and PSJA school districts joined the many Valley school districts that are opting out of Senate Bill 11 (SB 11), which gives school boards the choice to adopt a policy for students and employees to participate in a period of prayer or reading of religious text during school day.
